summary: A typeset kurs ishi as an Uzbek kafedra expects it: formal title page (ruled blanks for every fact not given, the year from the clock), Mundarija with real page numbers, a Kirish of labelled parts, two or three chapters of numbered sections with a closing paragraph each (the kafedra plan word for word when given), Xulosa with proposals for applied topics, references only from what the customer supplied (a ruled form otherwise), and an optional appendix. 12 to 35 pages, default 25.
tone: Formal academic, impersonal third person, plain exact sentences, written to be read by a supervisor and a kafedra commission.
title: model

length.note: Sheets of the PDF, the title page and the contents included. Below 12 is built as 12: the title page, the contents, a two-page Kirish, three chapters of two pages each (a kafedra plan may have three at any length), the Xulosa and the references are 12 page starts and fills. An appendix starts a page of its own, so it comes from 13 pages, where the shortest paper’s page starts leave it one, and is written in 40 to 250 words, its share standing for its page. The fixed parts’ shares stand for the room the template’s page starts, headings and boxes take, which skeleton.words cannot see at its generic words a page: they are set so the shortest and the default length fit at about 0.9 of each part’s top word count with no trim below 0.7 (rendered through the paper engine with stand-in blocks), a longer paper running short for the top-up to fill. A words-a-page figure per template would replace this.

prompt.uz: 📝 Titul varag‘i uchun ma’lumotlar. Bitta xabarda yozing: universitet, fakultet, kafedra, kurs va guruh, ismingiz, ilmiy rahbar, shahar. Yozmaganlaringiz o‘rnida qo‘lda to‘ldirish uchun chiziq qoladi.
prompt.ru: 📝 Данные для титульного листа. Одним сообщением: университет, факультет, кафедра, курс и группа, ваше имя, научный руководитель, город. Что не укажете, останется линией для заполнения от руки.
prompt.en: 📝 Title page details. In one message: university, faculty, department, year and group, your name, supervisor, city. Anything you skip stays a ruled line to fill in by hand.

hint.uz: Masalan: Misol davlat iqtisodiyot universiteti, Iqtisodiyot fakulteti, Marketing kafedrasi, 3-kurs, 312-guruh, Mirzayeva Mohinur, ilmiy rahbar dotsent Ravshanov B., Toshkent

fields.where: Title page, in capitals inside « », exactly as the customer wrote it (it must match the assignment letter for letter); the topic loop asks when it is missing.
Title page, line «…» fanidan above the topic; a ruled blank when missing, never inferred.
First line of the title page, only as the customer wrote it (the default ministry line and its allow-list are deferred).
Title page, bold capitals; one ruled blank captioned (universitet nomi) when missing.
Title page, the line under the university; left out when unknown.
Title page, printed as «Marketing» kafedrasi; a ruled blank when missing.
Title page, one line under the kafedra; a code only as the customer wrote it.
Title page, Bajardi block: «3-kurs 312-guruh talabasi»; ___-kurs ___-guruh when missing.
Title page, the Bajardi signature row, exactly as written; a ruled blank captioned (F.I.Sh.).
Title page, the Ilmiy rahbar block; a ruled blank captioned (F.I.Sh.) when missing.
Foot of the title page, «Toshkent – 2026»; never taken from the university’s name.
Foot of the title page after the city. Written by code from the Tashkent clock; a year the customer wrote wins. The model never writes one.
Not printed as a fact: what chapter 2 and the object part are about. Unnamed when the customer gave no name; never given a name, a region or a history.

parts.write: Nothing to write: the template draws the title page from the facts, and a fact not given is a ruled blank. Return each title-page fact exactly as the customer wrote it (apostrophes and quotation marks put right only): no title, group, course, code, ministry or city they did not give, no initials expanded, no name translated; the topic letter for letter, never extended. The student is the writer; a person with a rank or the words ilmiy rahbar, domla, dotsent or professor is the supervisor; when unclear, leave both out.
Nothing to write: the template lists the headings with the page each starts on.
One paragraph on why the topic matters now. Starts with the content itself, never restating the label.
One short paragraph. Name authors or works only when a source the customer supplied names them; otherwise say in general words which aspects are usually studied, and name no one.

Three to five tasks, one item each (in text, no label), each a verbal phrase ending in a semicolon, the last in a full stop. Each is answered later by a section and by one finding of the Xulosa, in the same order.
One sentence: what is studied. An enterprise the customer did not name stays generic («tanlangan korxona»).
One sentence: which side of the object is examined.
One or two sentences naming the methods used (analysis, comparison, generalisation, the customer’s own survey only when they described one). No law or decree named.
One or two sentences on where the results can be used.

The chapter: its title in heading (repeating the topic’s key words; from the customer’s plan word for word when one is given; no number, the template counts), and in body one to three sentences that say what the chapter examines. Chapter 1 is theory (concepts, development, classification, approaches), chapter 2 analysis or practice and the largest, chapter 3 only when the plan has it or the paper is 31 pages or more (proposals, a model, an implementation). A chapter not needed stays empty, its sections too.

The first section of this chapter: its title in heading (a sentence-case noun phrase of at most about 110 characters, no number or full stop), then academic prose in paragraphs of 4 to 7 sentences, one idea each; a term explained at first use, an abbreviation spelt out once. In chapter 2, figures only from the customer’s own data, quoted exactly with their unit and period; without data, the method: indicators, procedure and criteria, and one neutral sentence that the calculation is made on the object’s data. Empty when its chapter is.
The second section of this chapter, written as the first is. Empty when its chapter is.
A third section of this chapter, written as the first is: when the plan has it or the paper is 14 pages or more; otherwise empty.
One short closing paragraph of this chapter, with no heading: what the chapter established, leading into the next. No new facts. Empty when its chapter is.

Opens with «Mavzuni o‘rganish natijasida quyidagi xulosalarga kelindi.» («В результате исследования сделаны следующие выводы.», “The study leads to the following conclusions.”), then one finding per task of the Kirish in the same order (Birinchidan, Ikkinchidan …), each 1 to 3 sentences restating what the work established. No new facts or citations; a number only one the customer gave.
For an applied topic, two to four short proposals that follow from chapter 2, one item each (in text, no label). For a theoretical topic, none.

One item per source the customer typed or attached, in the standard form and completing nothing: no publisher, year, pages or URL they did not give. An attached file is described only from what its own first pages show, never by its file name. Normative acts first, then books and articles alphabetically, then online sources. With no source given, no item: the template draws numbered lines to fill in by hand.

Only when the customer asks for an appendix: material they supplied (their data, a questionnaire, a list of terms), or a glossary of this paper’s terms in your own words, one item each (label the term or the title, text its content). Never data, forms or sources of your own.

rules.text: Voice: impersonal academic third person (tahlil qilindi, aniqlandi; рассмотрено, выявлено; is examined). Never first person, never the reader addressed, no experience claims, no «bu bobda biz», no colloquial words or filler, no markdown or headings inside a body. Plain, short, exact sentences, written so the student can explain them at the defence.

A kafedra plan the customer gives (in the message or a file) is followed word for word: its chapter and section titles are the headings, in order, and no point is added, merged, dropped or reordered. A paper has at most three chapters: a plan of more keeps every heading in order, the later chapters’ titles written as sections of the third. Without a plan, two chapters of two or three sections; three chapters only from 31 pages.

Facts: never a person, organisation, enterprise name, date, number, percentage, statistic, law or decree number, quotation, survey, experiment, author, title, publisher, page or web address that the message or the files do not contain. A definition, a well-known event with its year or the name of a well-known law without its number may be used in the Kirish and chapter 1. Nothing about the customer’s enterprise beyond what they wrote: not how it sells, when it started or what it changed.
The customer’s own figures are compared honestly, in words: which grew and which fell, never a percentage, ratio or total you computed, and never a cause claimed from two series moving together.

With attached files, their facts, terms and order of ideas are the content, paraphrased in your own words; quotations rare, short and in « ». Write no citation marks ([1]) and no footnotes; a work that is only named goes into the references and nowhere else. No tables, pictures, charts or code listings in the text.
Never authored: the task sheet, deadlines, signatures, the supervisor’s review, the defence date, the commission, the grade.

Uzbek is Latin only, o‘ and g‘ with ‘ and the tutuq with ’, quotation marks « »; Russian « », English “ ” and the words course paper. Fixed headings and the Kirish labels are drawn by the template: a body never repeats its label («Kurs ishining obyekti. Kurs ishining obyekti — …» is a defect).

prompt.uz:
📚 Kurs ishining mavzusi va fanini yozing. Sahifalar sonini ham ayting (aytmasangiz, 25; 12 dan 35 gacha). Titul varag‘i va mundarija ham shu songa kiradi.
📎 Kafedra rejasi, raqamlaringiz yoki manbalaringiz bo‘lsa, PDF, Word yoki TXT fayl qo‘shing. Ilova kerak bo‘lsa, shuni ham yozing.
Raqam va manbalar faqat sizdan olinadi. Manba bermasangiz, adabiyotlar ro‘yxati qo‘lda to‘ldirish uchun bo‘sh qatorlar bo‘lib chiqadi.
prompt.ru:
📚 Напишите тему и предмет курсовой. Укажите и число страниц (если не укажете, 25; от 12 до 35). Титульный лист и оглавление входят в это число.
📎 Если есть план кафедры, ваши цифры или источники, добавьте файл PDF, Word или TXT. Нужно приложение — напишите и об этом.
Цифры и источники берутся только у вас. Без источников список литературы будет пустыми строками для заполнения от руки.
prompt.en:
📚 Write the topic and the subject of your course paper. Add the number of pages too (25 if you don’t; 12 to 35). The title page and the contents count among them.
📎 If you have the department’s plan, your figures or sources, attach a PDF, Word or TXT file. If you need an appendix, say so.
Figures and sources are taken only from you. Without sources the reference list is blank lines to fill in by hand.

examples.uz: Marketing asoslari fanidan kurs ishi kerak: «Kichik biznesda ijtimoiy tarmoqlar orqali marketing». 25 sahifa, 2 bob. Ikkinchi bobda qandolatchilik do‘konimning sotuvini tahlil qiling: 2023-yilda 120 mln, 2024-yilda 168 mln so‘m.
examples.ru: Нужна курсовая по предмету «Основы маркетинга»: «Маркетинг малого бизнеса в социальных сетях». 25 страниц, 2 главы. Во второй главе проанализируйте продажи моей кондитерской: 2023 год — 120 млн сумов, 2024 год — 168 млн сумов.
examples.en: I need a course paper for Principles of Marketing: “Marketing small businesses through social networks”. 25 pages, 2 chapters. In chapter 2 analyse the sales of my pastry shop: 120 million sum in 2023, 168 million sum in 2024.

examples.uz: Pedagogika fanidan kurs ishi: «Boshlang‘ich sinflarda o‘qish ko‘nikmasini rivojlantirish». 30 sahifa. Kafedra bergan reja va manbalar ilova qilingan PDF faylda, rejaga aynan amal qiling.
examples.ru: Курсовая по педагогике: «Развитие навыка чтения в начальных классах». 30 страниц. План кафедры и источники в приложенном PDF-файле, следуйте плану точно.
examples.en: A course paper for Pedagogy: “Developing reading skills in primary school”. 30 pages. The department’s plan and the sources are in the attached PDF; follow the plan exactly.

examples.uz: Ona tili fanidan kurs ishi: «O‘zbek tilida sifatlarning ma’noviy guruhlari». 20 sahifa: 1-bob nazariy qism, 2-bob tahlil. Atamalar lug‘atini ilovaga qo‘ying.
examples.ru: Курсовая по узбекскому языку: «Смысловые группы прилагательных в узбекском языке». 20 страниц: глава 1 — теория, глава 2 — анализ. Словарь терминов вынесите в приложение.
examples.en: A course paper in Uzbek language: “Semantic groups of adjectives in Uzbek”. 20 pages: chapter 1 theory, chapter 2 analysis. Put a glossary of terms in an appendix.

pool.uz: Moliya fanidan kurs ishi kerak, mavzu: «Tijorat banklarida kredit riskini boshqarish». 28 sahifa. Misol davlat iqtisodiyot universiteti, 3-kurs, 312-guruh, Mirzayeva Mohinur. Ilmiy rahbar: dotsent Ravshanov B. Toshkent.
pool.ru: Нужна курсовая по финансам на тему «Управление кредитным риском в коммерческих банках». 28 страниц. Примерный государственный экономический университет, 3 курс, группа 312, Мирзаева Мохинур. Научный руководитель: доцент Равшанов Б. Ташкент.
pool.en: I need a course paper in finance: “Managing credit risk in commercial banks”. 28 pages. Example State University of Economics, year 3, group 312, Mohinur Mirzayeva. Supervisor: Assoc. Prof. B. Ravshanov. Tashkent.

finished.uz: 📄 Kurs ishi tayyor. Titul varag‘idagi bo‘sh chiziqlarni qo‘lda to‘ldiring. Adabiyotlar ro‘yxatida faqat siz bergan manbalar bor; kafedralar odatda 20–25 ta manba so‘raydi, qolganini o‘zingiz qo‘shasiz.
finished.ru: 📄 Курсовая готова. Пустые строки на титульном листе заполните от руки. В списке литературы только ваши источники; кафедры обычно требуют 20–25, остальные добавьте сами.
finished.en: 📄 Your course paper is ready. Fill in the blank lines on the title page by hand. The reference list holds only your sources; departments usually expect 20–25, so add the rest yourself.

blanks.uz: Siz bermagan ma’lumot o‘rniga bo‘sh joy qoldirildi: uni o‘zingiz to‘ldiring.
blanks.ru: Где данных не было, оставлены пустые места: заполните их сами.
blanks.en: Where you gave no details, blanks were left for you to fill in.

gates: A native Uzbek and a native Russian reader check the Kirish labels, the fixed headings, the Xulosa formula, the title-page labels of academic_kurs_ishi and the bot copy.
Samples of 12, 25 and 35 pages in uz, ru and en, with and without the customer’s figures and plan, are drawn with the paper sample tool next to units/pdf.kurs_ishi/mock/academic_kurs_ishi.png.

The shortest paper, 12 pages, is sampled with the paper sample tool in uz, ru and en with no source and with a three-chapter plan, and it ends on page 12 with no longer_than_quoted and no trim below 0.7.
A paper made from bot example 1 shows only the customer’s two sales figures in chapter 2, and one made from a two-chapter kafedra plan keeps every heading word for word.
The facts corpus is at zero on this entry’s examples and pool, and one real-provider run (scripts/operations/ai_smoke.py --category pdf.kurs_ishi) is read before the tick.

later.text: The task sheet (Kurs ishiga topshiriq) and the supervisor’s review form (Taqriz) as optional sheets.
Citation marks [n] for sources whose text was supplied, foot-of-page notes, and the READ/LISTED source classes: this round the text carries no marks.
Derived values computed by code (changes in percent, ratios, totals) handed to the model, and tables of the customer’s figures with derived columns.

The four-stage pipeline (outline call, one call per chapter in parallel, Kirish and Xulosa from the chapters, one expand call), progress messages from 16 pages, a corrective retry of the number check.
The ministry line printed by default from an allow-list, the frame some kafedras ask for, a Times-metric face and the justified hyphenated setting.
